sentences.text: Azithromycin is an antibiotic useful for the treatment of a number of bacterial infections .	antibiotic	antibiotic

This includes middle ear infections , strep throat , pneumonia , traveler 's diarrhea , and certain other intestinal infections .	middle ear infections	otitis media	strep throat	strep throat	pneumonia	pneumonia	intestinal infections	gastroenteritis	diarrhea	diarrhea

It may also be used for a number of sexually transmitted infections including chlamydia and gonorrhea infections .	sexually transmitted infections	sexually transmitted infections	chlamydia	chlamydia infections
Along with other medications , it may also be used for malaria .	malaria	malaria
It can be taken by mouth or intravenously with doses once per day .	intravenously	intravenously
Common side effects include nausea , vomiting , diarrhea and upset stomach .	nausea	nausea	vomiting	vomiting	diarrhea	diarrhea
An allergic reaction or a type of diarrhea caused by Clostridium difficile is possible .	diarrhea	diarrhea
No harm has been found with its use during pregnancy .
Its safety during breastfeeding is not confirmed , but it is likely safe .	breastfeeding	breastfeeding
Azithromycin is an azalide , a type of macrolide antibiotic .	antibiotic	antibiotic	azalide	azalide	macrolide	macrolide
It works by decreasing the production of protein , thus stopping bacterial growth .
It is on the World Health Organization 's List of Essential Medicines , the most effective and safe medicines needed in a health system .	health system	health system
It is available as a generic medication and is sold under many trade names worldwide .	generic medication	generic medication
The wholesale cost in the developing world is about 0.18 to 2.98 USD per dose .	developing world	developing world
In the United States it is about 33 USD for a course of treatment .
